Risk_Description: Nominal 125 mm embedment violates ETA-20/0541 minimum slab thickness (h_min = 161 mm > 150 mm slab); reduced 80 mm embedment carries rebar clash risk
Engineering_Impact: Potential anchor blow-through on bottom slab face or core drilling damage to main flexural reinforcement bars
Current_Mitigation: Nominal 125 mm blocked as physically infeasible; reduced 80 mm classified as conditionally feasible with rebar_clash_risk_flag=True and concrete breakout check phi_Ncbg=66.36 kN > 18.50 kN
Required_Physical_Action: Mandatory non-destructive GPR (Ground Penetrating Radar) concrete rebar scan prior to drilling; consider reinforced plinth upstands or through-bolts

Risk_Description: In-situ concrete compressive strength is assumed at M20 (fck = 20 MPa) without physical core testing or NDT verification
Engineering_Impact: Overestimation of concrete cone breakout shear capacity or baseplate bearing crushing under column reactions
Current_Mitigation: INSPECTION_REQUIRED_HOLD and ASSUMED_DATA_CERTIFICATION_HOLD active in registry; 0.70 cracked concrete deration applied
Required_Physical_Action: On-site NDT testing (Rebound Hammer per IS 13311 Part 2 and Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity per Part 1) with core extraction if rebound indices are erratic

Risk_Description: Diaphragm shear stiffness and load transfer from purlins to roof sheeting relies on unverified field fastener installation
Engineering_Impact: Fly-bracing lateral restraint adequacy requires stiff diaphragm support; unverified diaphragm could allow purlin roll or rafter LTB
Current_Mitigation: Fly bracing status classified as CONDITIONALLY_ADEQUATE_PENDING_SITE_DIAPHRAGM_VERIFICATION; series spring model models web flexibility; FASTENER_TORQUE_UNVERIFIED_HOLD active
Required_Physical_Action: Site inspection of sheet-to-purlin self-drilling screw frequency edge distance and tightening torque validation

Risk_Description: Field installation workmanship chemical resin mixing quality and hole cleaning cannot be verified by calculation alone
Engineering_Impact: Anchor premature slippage bond failure or tension pullout during peak cyclonic wind gust
Current_Mitigation: Project-specific testing protocol established (1.5x factored uplift = 27.75 kN proof load on 25% of anchors with 0.20 mm max slip)
Required_Physical_Action: Physical on-site proof load testing using calibrated hydraulic pull rig witnessed and certified by RSE

Risk_Description: Standard 14 mm clearance holes in cleats allow 2 mm slip before bearing engagement if standard non-preloaded bolts are used
Engineering_Impact: Flange lateral displacement before bracing activates degrading LTB critical moment Mcr
Current_Mitigation: Pre-tensioned HSFG M12 Grade 8.8 bolts or welded cleats made mandatory; slip capacity Vdsf=17.0 kN verified against 4.969 kN brace force (UR=0.292)
Required_Physical_Action: Use of calibrated torque wrench or direct tension indicators (DTI) during site erection with certified torque logs

Risk_Description: Simplified IS 875(3) Table 8 pressure coefficients may not account for localized corner/edge vortices or roof parapet wakes
Engineering_Impact: Localized canopy rafter overload or purlin clamp failure under micro-turbulent wind buffeting
Current_Mitigation: AERODYNAMIC_UNSUPPORTED_HOLD active in register; conservative 1.10 net uplift pressure coefficient used in rafter flexure check
Required_Physical_Action: Aerodynamic assessment by wind specialist or BLWT/CFD calibration if canopy tilt exceeds 15 deg or array is within 1.5 m of roof edge

Risk_Description: Cyclical wind uplift induces torsional roll and localized web bending in cold-formed Z/C purlins at fly-brace cleat connections
Engineering_Impact: Web crippling or progressive fatigue cracking at bolt holes under dynamic wind excitation
Current_Mitigation: Direct attachment to 2 mm purlin web without stiffened cleat is formally rejected; 6 mm stiffened cleat plate made mandatory
Required_Physical_Action: Verify fabrication of 6 mm stiffener cleats welded/bolted across full purlin web depth during shop inspection

Risk_Description: Host building framing column punching shear and reserve flexural capacity under canopy base moments (Mz = 4.90 kNm
Codal_Reference: Local slab shear distress or structural cracking around stanchion baseplates
Required_Physical_Action: Complete load path verification evaluates combined direct and eccentric punching shear tau_max = 0.304 MPa <= tau_c = 1.118 MPa (UR = 0.272)
Prerequisite_For_AFC_Release: Host building framing review and slab bottom reinforcement verification using original structural drawings or exploratory ferro-scanning

Engineering_Impact: Legal non-compliance under TNCDBR-2019 Rule 38 and building code enforcement liability
Codal_Reference: TNCDBR-2019 Rule 38 & Annexure XVII; NBC 2016 Part 2
Current_Mitigation: DRAWING_UNVERIFIED_HOLD enforces PRELIMINARY watermark and BLOCKED_AFC_LOCKED status across software and exports
